text:
ops-bot: Pager alert — elevated generation latency and 5xxs in ap-southeast. Affected route: /v1/generate. Error rate ~12% over last 5m. Paging @olivia (oncall). :rotating_light:

olivia (oncall): taking it. I’ll triage and loop infra. ETA initial findings ~10m.

olivia (oncall): quick checks — genqueue backlog up ~3.4x, tail latency to 2.3s, a spike of `ModelServingError` seen in logs. No alerts in upstream infra yet. Capturing sample logs now.

sam (sre): on standby. Can you paste a small log sample? I’ll look at routing, container OOMs, and recent deploys.

olivia (oncall): paste logs: ```[2025-07-12T18:35:03Z] ERROR ModelServingError request_id=abc123 status=500 model=redwood-falcon-7b svc=gen-aws-ap-southeast - kvcache miss + oom?
[2025-07-12T18:35:04Z] WARN slow_tokenize request_id=abc124 latency_ms=2300 route=/v1/generate```

maria (product): heads-up — customers may see failed completions and higher latency. We should draft a short status page blurb. Start with: ```Initial update: We are investigating elevated latency and error rates affecting text generation in AP-Southeast. Some requests may return errors or be slower than usual. Our on-call team is investigating and mitigating; we will post updates every 15 minutes.```

olivia (oncall): small wording tweak please: call out fallback: "We are enabling fallback routing to a compatible model to reduce customer impact while we investigate." Also note affected subset: non-streaming generation only.

sam (sre): mitigation plan — 1) scale gen workers in ap-southeast by +4 GPUs, 2) enable fallback routing to redwood-falcon-7b-compat, 3) clear local KV cache rows for hot keys. Running: `rbctl scale pool ap-southeast --add 4gpus && rbctl route enable-fallback --region ap-southeast --model redwood-falcon-7b-compat`

ops-bot: Action started: fallback routing enabled at 2025-07-12T18:42:11Z, autoscale request submitted. Will post follow-ups as metrics change. :white_check_mark:

kai (support): prepping quick customer note template for frontline: "We’re investigating elevated latency and errors for text generation in AP-Southeast. We’ve enabled fallback routing and are scaling capacity — reducing impact. ETA for next update 15 minutes."

maria (product): pushing the statuspage draft (final): ```We are currently experiencing elevated latency and increased error rates for text generation requests in AP‑Southeast. Some non-streaming requests may fail or be slower than normal. Our on-call and SRE teams are actively mitigating by enabling fallback routing and adding capacity. We will provide updates here every 15 minutes.``` Jay, legal — any concerns about posting this?

jay (legal): no legal objections to the language. Avoid mentioning specific customer names or internal config; fine to publish.

olivia (oncall): publishing now to status page and internal channel. Posted at 2025-07-12T18:44:05Z — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2025-07-12-apse-1 (ops: please confirm link posted).

ops-bot: Status page published. Initial impact note posted and linked. Monitoring for error-rate drop.

(15m later) olivia (oncall): UPDATE 1 — error rate down from 12% -> 3.1%, tail latency improved to ~800ms after fallback and scale. Continuing to monitor; rolling revert not safe yet until KV cache stability confirmed.

maria (product): updated public copy for Update 1: "We have reduced errors and latency via fallback routing and capacity scaling. Some customers may still see intermittent errors; teams are validating full recovery."

sam (sre): follow-up actions: run trace to identify hot key causing KV pressure, keep fallback in place for 1 hour, then gradual rollback if metrics remain stable. Command to capture traces: `rbctl trace collect --service gen-aws-ap-southeast --duration 10m --out /tmp/traces.tar`

(45m later) olivia (oncall): RESOLVED — metrics stable for 20m: error rate <0.5%, latency at baseline. We’ve disabled fallback and left autoscale in place to replenish capacity. Final resolution posted at 2025-07-12T19:33:20Z.

ops-bot: RESOLVED notice published to status page: ```Resolved: We have mitigated elevated latency and error rates affecting text generation in AP‑Southeast. The root cause appears to be a KV cache hot-key that caused service pressure; fixes include hot-key eviction and capacity scale. If you continue to see issues, contact support.``` :tada:

maria (product): will follow up with customer-facing post-incident summary with timeline and mitigation details once SRE completes RCA. Thanks team.

sam (sre): filing RCA ticket and attaching traces and timeline. Assigning to eng-ml for KV cache micro-optimization.

olivia (oncall): closing loop here. If anything regresses, reopen pager. Good work everyone. :raised_hands:
